run_bench_ivfflat_cuvs: run the IVF Flat GPU benchmark comparing cuVS vs classical training, adding, and search performance
run_bench_train_milliseconds: run the GPU index training benchmark measuring milliseconds for IVF Flat with cuVS enabled or disabled
run_bench_add_milliseconds: run the GPU index add benchmark measuring milliseconds to insert vectors with cuVS enabled or disabled
run_bench_search_milliseconds: run the GPU index search benchmark measuring milliseconds for k-NN queries with cuVS enabled or disabled
run_bench_ivfflat_cuvs_train_only: run the IVF Flat GPU benchmark with only the train operation enabled via the bm_train flag
